title: More Practical Enchantments
description: Adds 13 brand new balanced vanilla-style enchantments with configurable values and unique mechanics.
body:
# More Practical Enchantments | Quick Reference (1.20.1 Forge)
## 📦 Mod Info
- **Version**: Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge 47.x.x)
- **Author**: DY_XiaoJiaZi
- **Type**: Vanilla-Style Enchantment Expansion
- **Localization**: English / Chinese
- **Overview**: 23 new balanced enchantments with unique mechanics, configurable values, conflict rules and no overpowered gameplay.

## ✅ Core Features
- 23 brand-new enchantments for weapons, armor, tools, elytra and shields
- Balanced tier system, exclusive conflicts and reasonable trade-offs
- Full config support for all enchantment attributes
- Dedicated creative tab for quick enchantment testing
- Complete bilingual localization

## ⚔️ Weapon Enchantments
- **Lifesteal (I–V)**: Restores 5% damage dealt per level on hit. Max 25% lifesteal at V.
- **Swift Strike (I–V, Sword Only)**: +0.2 attack speed per level. Total +1.0 attack speed at V.
- **XP Boost (I–III)**: +100% mob kill XP per level. Max +300% XP bonus at III.
- **Pillager Fortune (I–III)**: Drops 1–3 extra emeralds on mob kills, scales with level.
- **Suppress (Single)**: Applies 3s Weakness on hit (all weapons).
- **Frost (Single, Bow/Crossbow Only)**: Slows targets and deals continuous frost damage. **Conflicts with Flame**.
- **Beheading (I–V)**: Grants mob/player head drop chance from 10% (I) to 50% (V).

## 🛡️ Armor Enchantments
- **Jump Boost (Single, Boots Only)**: Permanent Jump Boost effect.
- **Magma Protection (I–V)**: -20% fire/magma damage per level; full immunity at V. **Conflicts with Fire Protection / Armor Protection**.
- **Void Protection (Single)**: Safely teleports the player from void and grants 5s Slow Falling.
- **Sprint Boost (Single, Boots Only)**: Up to 50% movement speed bonus while sprinting.
- **Night Vision (Single, Helmet Only)**: Permanent Night Vision effect.
- **Catnip (Single, All Armor)**: Attracts cats and repels Creepers.
- **Deep Insight (Single, Helmet Only)**: Removes fog in water and lava for clear vision.
- **Cold Resistance (Single, Boots Only)**: Walk on powdered snow, immune to freeze damage. **Conflicts with Frost Walker**.
- **Luck Aura (I–III)**: Constant Luck effect; stack capped at Level III.
- **Armor Protection (I–V)**: Vanilla full damage reduction + 2 absorption hearts per level (max 10). Absorption regenerates after 5s of no damage. **Conflicts with all vanilla Protection & Magma Protection**.

## ⛏️ Tool Enchantments
- **Smelting (Single, Pickaxe/Shovel Only)**: Auto-smelts ores/sand while mining. **Conflicts with Silk Touch**, compatible with Fortune.

## 🌐 Universal Enchantments (All Equipment)
- **Natural Mending (I–V)**: Auto-recovers 1 durability after cooldown. Cooldowns: 15s / 12s / 9s / 6s / 3s.
- **Rebirth Bind (Single)**: Item persists on death instead of despawning.

## 🪂 Elytra Enchantments
- **Leap (Single)**: Provides forward acceleration during gliding without fireworks.

## 🛡️ Shield Enchantments
- **Steadfast (Single)**: Instantly resets shield cooldown when hit by axes.
